verdict.rationale: Docs and GitHub evidence show broad ingestion beyond chat: raw documents/URLs/files, multi-modal extractors (PDFs, images OCR, video transcripts, code), JSON-like memory objects via API `client.add`, and business-data connectors (Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub) with real-time sync. However, an independent community report describes a hands-on failure ingesting large content from a URL ('content was too large' error), a concrete limitation on the document-ingestion claim. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of JSON/structured business-data ingestion at scale, and resolution of the reported size-limit failure.
